moveSpeedState.description: The fixed state row supplying locomotion speed.

turnSpeedState.description: The fixed state row supplying turn speed.

controllers.description: Machine/device state-slot references used for controller pre-selection.

items.description: Two text state rows that identify one reconnect-stable controller.

machineState.description: The row containing the machine id.

deviceState.description: The row containing the device id.

voice.description: The identity's authored voice-babble selectors, or null for none (see WorldVoiceProfile).

patchId.description: The referenced Name (must resolve when declared).

cadenceTicks.description: The base inter-syllable tick spacing (must be positive when declared).
